description: Aetrova: a solo build for the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser. A mission-control dashboard for the Moon's south pole: compare landing sites and dates, see sunlight for power and line of sight to Earth's ground stations in a 360° horizon view, plus eclipses, signal delay and past missions. Built on real NASA and ISRO data (LOLA, Diviner, Chandrayaan-2/3), checked against NASA SPICE, with uncertainty shown. Three.js, React, Python, Supabase.
